note: Old-field and forest access in a bend of the St. Francis River west of Highway 67. MDC maps no campsites or parking lot; camping is allowed along the single dirt interior road that runs about half a mile south from County Road 302 through open fields, and MDC warns that road conditions vary. Spot length is not published. --Claude
summary: MDC lists 'Designated Camping Sites' + walk-in, but the brochure says 'Primitive camping is permitted along interior roads and on a walk-in basis'. GIS has no camping point and no lot; the 10/7/2025 map shows only one improved road (~0.8 km) with no camp or lot symbol. Imagery: a narrow dirt track through old fields, with no gravel pull-off or pad. No sites to find, so kept on the MDC tag with the caveat; fit/road condition is a question. Pin is on the track in the open field (fine); not waterfront kept; phone matches.
flags: SITES: none found. The area page lists 'Open Camping - Walk-in/Float-in/Backpack; Designated Camping Sites'. The brochure: 'Primitive camping is permitted along interior roads and on a walk-in basis. Campers are limited to 14 consecutive days in a 30-day period.' GIS layers 27 and 26 hold nothing for area 9239, and the 10/7/2025 area map shows one 'Improved Road' from CR 302 south through the area with no camping, parking or privy symbol. Kept on the MDC tag with the caveat, as the brief asks.

FIT QUESTION: the area page says 'This area has unimproved roads that are open to public vehicles. These roads may not be shown on area maps or posted with signs. Road conditions may vary.' The leaf-off imagery shows the interior road as a single-lane dirt track (~3-4 m) across an old field to the river bend, with no gravel lot or turnaround. A 23-ft rig could park on the field edge in dry weather, but there's no surfaced spot; it may be muddy after rain. AWH to decide whether roadside camping on a dirt track meets the bar. If a mapped pad is required, it's a drop candidate.
PIN: stored 37.30240,-90.46840 is on the track at the junction with a field lane, in the open field - fine for this layout (no lot to move to).
WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront, kept): the track ends ~45 m from the river through bank woods. The big gravel bar on the west bend is reached only on foot.
PHONE: (573) 663-7130 on the area page matches.
